description: Position, stated quietly. Dots report where the user is in a short sequence and nothing else.

MUST: Widen the active dot rather than only recolouring it, so position survives a colour-blind reading.
Expose the sequence as a single node reporting position and length, not as a row of anonymous dots.
Stay non-interactive unless each dot meets the density minimum.
SHOULD: Cap at a handful of dots. Beyond that, position is a number, not a picture.
NEVER: Become the only way to see progress through a flow.
